releaseGate: No live registration or activation without separately approved deployment/pilot checks

assembly.name: EmailProcess.Plugin
assembly.strongNameKey: External local SigningKeyPath MSBuild property; never committed

configuration.default: Embedded EmailProcess.Policy.json resource from EmailProcess.Plugin\policy.json; fails closed

roleIds: Approved effective Dataverse role GUID; both identity AND role required
customerResolutionStageCodes: Explicit approved identify-phase tool-stage code; separate from general stageCodes

observerStepIds: Exact registered async incident Update sdkmessageprocessingstep GUID
policyFields.cursorSigningKey: Base64 secret containing at least 32 random bytes

ordinarySteps.secureConfiguration: Optional full policy JSON override; absent/blank uses embedded resource
ordinarySteps.requiredConsistency: API, guard and observer policies must agree on observer step IDs and producer/admin identities

configuration.prohibition: Never put cursor secrets or producer policy in public unsecure configuration; protect compiled deployment artifacts

privilegeResolution.timing: After schema creation, before creating APIs
privilegeResolution.rule: Query exact named existing privilege records; require exactly one match. Abort if missing/ambiguous. These names are lookup candidates, not authority to invent privileges.
privilegeResolution.forbidden: Do not create arbitrary custom privileges or silently omit ExecutePrivilegeName

guardGroups.behavior: Allow only configured definition administrators with native table rights; published/used rows immutable; non-CRUD mutation messages denied
Only trusted transactional API-scoped Create/Update permitted; event Update/Delete always denied; no general Assign/share/retention bypass

messageResolution.rule: Resolve supported sdkmessage/sdkmessagefilter for each table and fail if a required core message cannot be protected. Register metadata-gated messages only when Dataverse exposes a supported filter. Verify all supported bulk mutation paths invoke guards before granting corresponding privileges.
messageResolution.missingGuardCoverage: Keep writer API unavailable and do not grant unguarded/bypass privileges
messageResolution.bypassPrivileges: Must not be assigned to producer/reader identities

observer.enableGate: Explicit pilot authorization plus proven images/version/caller table rights/native case messages and monitoring
observer.policyBootstrap: Create disabled step first, record its GUID, build approved API embedded policy and/or matching step secure configuration; only then activate under pilot gate
observer.overflow: Processed subset marked reconciliation-required; async job retries/logs. External paged worker remains unimplemented.
observer.originalCaseTransaction: Fail open because observer is asynchronous after commit
observer.nativeRetry: OperationStatus.Retry on Dataverse faults/timeouts; stop request immediately, never reuse failed API transaction
observer.noHistoricalImages: Read current case through API and mark explicit current-state reconciliation; do not fabricate pre/post history

activationOrder: Validate seven-table schema/field security, native rights and active unique indexes; take approved backup
Build and register signed dependent-assembly package through supported tooling; default producer policy remains deny-all
Register all runtime and definition mutation guards while writer APIs do not exist; verify guard coverage before native write grants
Create incident observer step and both images DISABLED; record step GUID
Build/re-register environment-specific embedded policy and matching secure step overrides as applicable
Resolve existing execute privileges and create read APIs and writer APIs with None custom-processing extensibility
Verify transaction rollback, idempotency, concurrency, caller/field security, parent-context guards and graph contracts
Generate official Code App service signatures and run read-only smoke checks
Enable producer adapters and then observer only after explicit controlled-pilot authorization
acceptanceNotYetProven: Actual Dataverse API IsInTransaction and parent-context propagation
Unique-key race rollback and complete-request concurrency retry
Caller role and record/field visibility, no SYSTEM impersonation
All direct and bulk mutation guard coverage
Connector/generated Code App API signatures and live round trips
